description: Per outlet from radar headlines: word-length distribution of the last 24 hours against the outlet's own other six days (symmetric chi-square), the outlet's usual spread of that distance and the ratio of today to usual, with Herdan's beta. Verdicts collecting or measured; lists the outlets most unlike their own usual. A high ratio is a reason to look at the headlines (topic wave, rewrite, feed change, pasted batch), never a verdict on who wrote them. Rule-based, no AI. In honour of Thomas Corwin Mendenhall (1841-1924), who counted word lengths as an author's fingerprint.
name: get_mendenhall
title: Mendenhall sensor: does an outlet's headline batch read like that outlet's own usual (word-length curve)
